---
title: "Central Park Weather, 2010"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

data("ny_noaa")

# Select Central Park weather records for 2010
weather_data =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(
    id == "USW00094728",
    date >= "2010-01-01",
    date <= "2010-12-31"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tmax_c = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE)
  )
```

Column {data-width=600}
-------------------------------------

# Daily maximum temperature

```{r}
temperature_plot =
  weather_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax_c)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Maximum temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(temperature_plot)
```

Column {data-width=400}
-------------------------------------

# Maximum temperature by month

```{r}
distribution_plot =
  weather_data |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax_c)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = tmax_c)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "lightblue",
    outlier.size = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Maximum temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(distribution_plot)
```

# Recorded snowfall days by month

```{r}
snow_summary =
  weather_data |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    observed_days = sum(!is.na(snow)),
    snowfall_days = sum(snow > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(observed_days > 0)

snow_plot =
  snow_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = snowfall_days)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Days with recorded snowfall"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(snow_plot)
```

Counts include only days with recorded snowfall data.
Months with no recorded snowfall data are omitted.
